purpose: Bind the frozen final-resolution, policy-chronology and tradability semantics to exact repository artifacts and an ex-ante trusted contract-registry receipt before any future implementation may acquire scientific authority.

review_scope.safe_review_rule: Absence of runtime implementation is not itself evidence that this predeclaration grants unsafe authority: all authority remains false. Any later implementation, migration, deployment, receipt verification and metrics enablement require separate exact-head review and runtime proof.
review_scope.forbidden_interpretation: Do not treat this contract-only PR as proof that final resolution or tradable-2x classification is already implemented, deployed, calibrated, profitable or operational.

contract_bundle_identity.bundle_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256(domain + NUL + repeated(path + NUL + member_sha256_hex + LF))
requirements: The exact UTF-8 bytes of every governed contract are hashed independently.
The bundle fingerprint is computed over the frozen domain plus lexicographically ordered path and member-digest pairs.
Changing any governed contract byte, path, contract identity or member set creates a different bundle identity and cannot silently inherit authority from an earlier bundle.
The exact bundle fingerprint used by a formation must be retained in the trusted policy/formation lineage and independently re-verifiable from the deployed contract files.

The tradability companion additionally requires the trusted registry to bind the exact SHA-256 of money_intelligence/2x_tradability_precommitment_v1.json plus its schema/artifact_id; path or artifact_id alone is not enough.

receipt_must_bind: all governed contract ids and schemas
all governed contract member SHA-256 digests
policy chronology contract id and version
tradability companion contract id and version
tradability precommitment artifact id/schema/exact deployed file SHA-256
trusted_contract_registry.confirmatory_chronology_rule: For prospective confirmatory authority, the compatible trusted contract-registry, policy and execution-policy receipts must exist at or before trusted server formation time and before governed post-formation price or microstructure evidence is acquired or consumed by the resolution process.
trusted_contract_registry.runtime_fail_closed_rule: A runtime implementation must refuse authoritative final resolution, tradable-success labeling, factory metrics, calibration and model fitting unless the deployed contract bundle re-hashes to the exact trusted registry receipt, the frozen tradability precommitment digest verifies, and the policy-chronology and tradability companions independently verify.
trusted_contract_registry.mutation_rule: A changed contract bundle or changed tradability precommitment is a new lineage. It cannot rewrite formations already exposed to governed outcome evidence.

formation_binding.universe_rule: Membership and asset identity are frozen at formation from timestamp-safe evidence; later survival, relisting, renaming, taxonomy or present-day universe membership cannot add, remove or relabel the formation.
formation_binding.identity_transplant_rule: Evidence or resolution lineage bound to one canonical asset/venue/instrument cannot be transplanted to another even if timestamps and raw hashes otherwise verify.
formation_binding.tradability_rule: A trusted +100% price crossing alone cannot grant primary factory-success authority. The frozen band/venue execution policy and tradability companion must verify independently.

lineage_and_revision.git_history_role: Repository history is supporting audit evidence, not runtime scientific authority by itself.
lineage_and_revision.append_only_runtime_rule: Scientific authority requires the trusted contract-registry receipt plus the parent/chronology/tradability closure and resolution receipts; editable repository prose alone never grants authority.
lineage_and_revision.later_contract_version_rule: A later contract version applies only to new compatible formations or an explicitly predeclared research-only migration cohort. It cannot retroactively create confirmatory prospective performance for an older exposed formation.
lineage_and_revision.supersession_rule: Outcome-evidence supersession may update price or microstructure evidence lineage only inside the same ex-ante contract/policy/execution-policy lineage unless a separately predeclared migration explicitly removes confirmatory authority.

mandatory_ci_guards: all governed contract files parse as JSON and retain their exact required contract ids and PREDECLARED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED status
the chronology and tradability companions require and name the exact parent contract
all authority booleans in the parent, chronology companion, tradability companion and this gate remain false in this preimplementation PR
the governed member set and bundle-fingerprint algorithm are deterministic
a one-byte mutation of any governed contract changes its member digest and bundle fingerprint

formation binding requires trusted server time, canonical asset, exact venue/instrument, PIT universe membership, frozen price/horizon/target, contract-bundle, policy-receipt and execution-policy identities
the tradability companion anchors 2X-TRADABILITY-001-v1 and keeps raw PRICE_2X_CROSSING distinct from TRADABLE_2X_HIT_AT_BAND
missing crossing-side microstructure remains PRICE_HIT_TRADABILITY_UNKNOWN and ADV/volume alone cannot establish tradable success
no test fixture may grant authoritative final resolution or tradable factory success merely because contract files exist
